title: Inline leg row with strike steppers, lots list and an editable price (G-05-3)
reference_behaviour: Each leg row in the builder has its own expiry list, strike minus and plus steppers that snap to the strike gap, a lots list and an editable price.
ours: REQ-076 AC-1 (steppers) not built; legs are added through a separate form with four selects and a lots box. Typed price is REQ-077 AC-1.
